description: A dependency-free accessible task-list web app; this milestone validates this specific product contract, not arbitrary websites.
acceptance_criteria: The page has a main landmark and a visible heading.
A text input labeled New task and a button named Add task add nonempty tasks.
Each task is in an element with data-testid=task-item and has a checkbox labeled with the task text.
Checking a task marks it complete; unchecking makes it active.
Buttons named All, Active, and Completed filter visible tasks correctly.
Each task has a button named Delete followed by the task text; deleting removes that task only.
Tasks and completion state persist in localStorage and survive a page reload.
Empty and whitespace-only input adds no task.
HTML-looking task input is displayed literally and cannot create DOM elements or execute script.
limitations: The acceptance suite is fixed, disclosed, and finite. Passing it is not proof of arbitrary correctness or resistance to deliberate test gaming.
No server-side code, dependency install, backend, external network, deployment, or user identity service is supported.
Other project families require additional trusted profiles and suites before execution.
